A legacy FEniCS/DOLFIN heat-conduction template `/home/user/Desktop/thermal_subdomain_base.py` is provided. Run the script with the legacy `dolfin` API used by the template (for example, FEniCS/DOLFIN 2019.1.0), not DOLFINx. Before starting the work, run legacy FEniCS with `/home/user/miniconda3/bin/conda run --no-capture-output --prefix /home/user/miniconda3/envs/fenics-legacy python` when working on `thermal_subdomain_base.py`.

Complete the following: 1. Modify and generate `/home/user/Desktop/thermal.py`: - Use `MeshFunction("size_t", mesh, 2)` to mark left and right subdomains - Thermal conductivity: left half `k=50`, right half `k=10` - Left Dirichlet boundary `100°C`, right Dirichlet boundary `20°C` - Solve the steady temperature field 2. Extract and save to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Temperature at interface `x=50 mm` - Temperature at point `(25, 25)` Format: `interface_temp, center_temp`
